target_context.context_rationale: Prepared structure is an agonist/transducer-bound complex (9W2H) with signaling partners and Nb35 present; this does not establish inhibitory efficacy of a new VHH and may distort pocket exposure. Every arm's not_binding inherits runtime-verified intracellular topology and G-protein/arrestin-facing contacts (gpcr_exclusions) plus arm-specific avoids; Site exclusions are empty. Avoid lists are contact constraints, not membrane/glycan/approach simulations. Agonist-mimic risk and whole-VHH clearance remain unresolved.

limitations: Only mapped, coordinate-present receptor residues enter not_binding. Absent coordinates and unannotated partners are not invented. Annotation provenance is retained; it is not independent experimental certification.
not_binding constrains contacts; it is not a membrane or accessibility simulation.
